title: I Made a 3D Chess Game with Singleplayer, Multiplayer, and Tutorial Mode
author: derAres
selftext:
Workflow/Details:

* Character Design by ChatGPT
* Models
   * Flat image to 3D Model: Meshy
   * Rigging: Adobe Mixamo
   * Animations: Adobe Mixamo
   * Black version of each model: Had claude build me a tool to paint on the model textures of the white base version
   * Low Poly versions of the model: Had claude make low poly versions as loading time and performance was bad, especially on mobile - now ok
* Sounds
   * Elevenlabs
* Music
   * Free tracks I found online
* Coding
   * Claude code in terminal
* Tech stack:
   * The chess game is a Node.js/Express app with a vanilla-JavaScript + three.js frontend (no framework, no build step) that uses chess.js for the rules and ws WebSockets for invite-only multiplayer, with a built-in minimax AI for single-player and Web Audio for sound.

One tip: if you're using Meshy + Mixamo, try running the models through a quick decimation pass in Blender before Mixamo rigging — it keeps the animations clean while cutting the poly count way down, which helps a ton with mobile performance without needing separate low-poly versions.
